name: Tiny House Coffee Roasters
notes: Roaster whose full catalog is whole-bean coffee, cold brew concentrate and kegs, subscriptions and merch, with no drippers or brewing gear (https://tinyhousecoffeeroasters.com/collections/all). Site lists 120 Precision Drive Unit B100, Buda as a warehouse open by appointment only (https://tinyhousecoffeeroasters.com/).

name: Callahan's General Store
notes: General store at 501 S Hwy 183 (western wear, hardware, feed); its Home and Garden page lists Lodge cast iron, canning and kitchen gadgets but no coffee drippers or coffee makers (https://callahansgs.com/homeandgarden/).

name: CoffeePeople
notes: Cafe inside BookPeople serving coffee drinks and food for dine-in and takeout, with no brewing gear listed (https://bookpeople.com/cafe). Yelp lists it at 603 N Lamar Blvd, updated May 2026 (https://www.yelp.com/biz/coffeepeople-austin-3).

name: Cutco® Kitchen
notes: Cutco sells knives, cutlery sets, cooking tools, tableware and outdoor knives, with no coffee brewing equipment (https://cutco.com/). The Austin store at 3201 Bee Caves Rd is listed on Yelp, updated September 2026 (https://www.yelp.com/biz/cutco-kitchen-austin-2).

name: Amherst Market
notes: Site domain does not resolve (DNS not found). Directory listings show a grocery/convenience store with a deli at 259 Triangle St, licensed as Amherst Market since 2020, with no clothing (https://www.merchantcircle.com/amherst-market2-amherst-ma, https://maps.apple.com/place?place-id=IA3A1D92C11F5098D).

name: Wendell Country Store
notes: Country store selling milk, eggs, groceries, beer, wine, snacks and movies, with no clothing or rain gear listed; blog last posted 2011 (https://wendellcountrystore.wordpress.com/). Yelp lists it at 57 Lockes Village Rd, updated April 2026 (https://www.yelp.com/biz/wendell-country-store-wendell).

name: Hilton's Tent City
notes: Outdoor gear and apparel store listing rain jackets such as the Marmot PreCip Eco Jacket and a Marmot GORE-TEX jacket, at 565 Mass Ave, Cambridge, open Mon-Sat 11-6 (https://hiltonstentcity.com/).

name: AT&T Store
notes: AT&T store page for 291 N York St lists phones, cases, phone chargers, headphones and wearables; no AA or rechargeable household batteries (https://att.com/stores/illinois/elmhurst/81521?wtExtndSource=stores).

name: Verizon
notes: Russell Cellular is a Verizon authorized retailer selling phones, tablets, cases, chargers and protection plans, not household batteries (https://russellcellular.com/). Verizon's locator lists Russell Cellular Northlake at 75 W North Ave (https://www.verizon.com/stores/details/illinois/northlake/russell-cellular-northlake-1361722/).

name: BOND'S Television & Electronics
notes: Site returned HTTP 403 to the fetch, while search-indexed pages show it live. Listings describe a home theater and TV sales/service business at 1010 W Lynn St, with no mention of USB-C cables (https://www.yelp.com/biz/bonds-television-and-electronics-austin-4, https://www.bbb.org/us/tx/austin/profile/home-theater-systems/bonds-television-electronics-0825-39228).

name: CompuPlus
address: 5555 N Lamar Blvd Ste C122, Austin, TX 78751
notes: Computer and phone repair shop at 5555 N Lamar Blvd Suite C122 with posted hours; its online catalog shows used laptops, parts and a KVM switch but no USB-C cables (https://compuplus.shop/, https://www.compuplus.shop/category/all-products).

name: Dollar General
address: 241 N Grundy Quarles Hwy, Gainesboro, TN 38562
notes: Chain catalog lists a Wooden Train Set and a Melissa & Doug wooden stacking train (https://www.dollargeneral.com/p/wooden-train-set/653899617172); this is chain-level evidence, not store-level stock. Store page returned HTTP 401 to the fetch; Yelp lists the store at 241 N Grundy Quarles Hwy, updated November 2025 (https://www.yelp.com/biz/dollar-general-gainesboro).

name: Kid to Kid Brentwood
notes: Resale kids store at 95 Seaboard Ln with posted hours; it sells used toys, puzzles and books, but inventory varies and no train sets are listed (https://kidtokid.com/brentwood).

name: The Museum Store
address: 222 Rep. John Lewis Way S, Nashville, TN 37203
notes: Country Music Hall of Fame shop at 222 Rep. John Lewis Way S, open daily; its kids section and a search for "train" return music books, records, apparel and plush, with no toy trains (https://shop.countrymusichalloffame.org/search?q=train).

name: Wildhorse Gift Shop
notes: Wildhorse Saloon at 120 2nd Ave N closed in January 2024 and the building is being reopened as Category 10 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wildhorse_Saloon). The URL redirects to shop.opry.com, whose search for "train" shows no toy trains (https://shop.opry.com/search?q=train).

name: Designer Fabrics (by appt only) Hunter Douglas Dealer
notes: By-appointment Hunter Douglas window treatment and custom drapery/upholstery business at 2555 E Jamison Ave; no blankets offered (https://designerfabricsdenver.com/).

name: Allyn's Fabric and Bridal
notes: Bridal, special-occasion and apparel fabric and notions shop; no finished blankets (https://allynsfabricandbridal.com/). Contact page lists 3200 S Acoma St, Englewood with Tue-Sat hours (https://allynsfabricandbridal.com/pages/contact).

name: Ibraheems Rugs
notes: Handmade and oriental rug and furniture showroom; menu lists only rug categories, no blankets or throws (https://www.ibraheems.com/). Contact page names 5090 Acoma St as the showroom, though the homepage also shows 636 S Broadway (https://ibraheems.com/contact).

name: Treelotta: Fabric + Craft Studio
notes: Fabric and craft store selling wool and wool felt by the yard plus yarn, but no finished blankets (https://treelotta.com/). Yelp lists it at 3370 S Broadway, updated June 2026 (https://www.yelp.com/biz/treelotta-fabric-craft-studio-englewood).

name: Yarn Shoppe Denver
notes: Yarn store at 331 14th St #216 with posted hours, selling hand-dyed yarn, classes and handmade bags; no blankets or throws (https://yarnshoppedenver.com/).

name: Dollar General
address: 1241 A Moreland Ave SE, Atlanta, GA 30316
notes: Chain catalog shows crew, work and cozy socks but no wool socks (https://www.dollargeneral.com/c/apparel/socks-for-the-family). Store page returned HTTP 401 to the fetch; Yelp lists the store at 1241 A Moreland Ave SE, updated May 2026 (https://www.yelp.com/biz/dollar-general-atlanta-12).
